value.rationale: The 2026 paper sharply separates star and complete graph extremes but leaves the full interval unresolved by maximum degree. An arbitrary peripheral-clique-partition classification fills the interval with an explicit root, establishes strict survival-threshold improvement under natural clique coarsening, gives all-positive initial-condition global outcomes, and determines sharp non-hyperbolic extinction and leaf response constants. The result motivates topology-sensitive ecological robustness beyond a one-off example while clearly limiting itself to symmetric competition.
